posts.title: Millennium Video: a zine
posts.description: Niko and I made a zine in honor of browsing the video rental store racks and picking something (probably terrible) to bring home to watch. 24 pages. You can read it here or download the PDF. Free.

posts.title: you hate haircuts: a zine
posts.description: I made a stupid little zine about how I, personally, don’t like getting haircuts. You can read it or download the pdf for free here. 16 pages.
